description: The bar chart, titled "Recall@10," compares the performance of four different methods—labeled "Ours," "- critiquing," "- scoring," and "- ranking"—on a metric measuring recall at the top 10 recommendations. The vertical axis represents the Recall@10 score, ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, while the horizontal axis lists the four methods. The "Ours" method, represented by an orange bar, achieves the highest score, with a value of approximately 0.35. The "- critiquing" method, shown in blue, has a score of about 0.3. The "- scoring" method has a score of approximately 0.15, and the "- ranking" method has a score of about 0.25. The chart visually demonstrates that the "Ours" method outperforms the other three methods in terms of Recall@10.
